basic_info.title: MoveGPT / TrajMoE: Scaling Mobility Foundation Models with Spatially-Aware Mixture of Experts
authors: not fully confirmed from abstract page

method.graph_integration: none (location units, notes fragmentation of basic units as key obstacle)
method.notes: Scales mobility foundation models across cities via spatially-aware mixture-of-experts; identifies inconsistent movement units (raw GPS vs non-transferable zone IDs) as THE obstacle to cross-city pretraining and geographic scalability. Cited with UniTraj as evidence that mobility-domain scaling wins come from data/coverage and unit design, not raw parameter growth — supporting the data-first ordering in run2_capacity_diagnosis_and_scaling_review.md.

gap_analysis.whats_missing: Human-mobility prediction, not GPS-to-road-segment matching; no road graph, no world model, no RL.
gap_analysis.novelty_reasoning: Adjacent scaling evidence; the cross-city unit-consistency problem it names is exactly what a road-graph-anchored representation (this project's P1b) sidesteps.

relevance.bmw_relevance: Indirect: MoE-across-cities is a candidate pattern if per-city retraining cost becomes the binding product constraint.

uncertain: Authors/venue not verified beyond arXiv listing (2026-07-11 search pass); v1/v2 naming (TrajMoE vs MoveGPT) suggests in-flight revisions.
